source.test: A. prog/c25k: every literal the evaluator read shows its number in the description

ret: 1 training day (R) holding 1 exercise, over block weeks train, repeating.
Block weeks: train, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed.
Rotation: Each training week: Day R, then Day R, then Day R.

Attendance: Train at least 3 times in each 7-day window (from your start day); leave at least 2 days between workouts. If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
run: Couch to 5K: nine weeks of run/walk sessions, three a week; move to the next week after three sessions with every run completed, and repeat the week if you have to stop a run.
Hands on weekReached: the run slot's programme week when the program ends.
Couch to 5K: nine weeks of run/walk sessions, three a week; move to the next week after three sessions with every run completed, and repeat the week if you have to stop a run
Starts with programme week = 0; written by session, owner.
Starts with completed sessions this week = 0; written by session, owner.

Plan: The entry at position your programme week (from 0, holding at the last) of: #0 Run, with brisk-walk recoveries: warm-up 5 min; 8 times: (1 min, then recovery 1:30 min); recovery 5 min; #1 Run, with brisk-walk recoveries: warm-up 5 min; 6 times: (1:30 min, then recovery 2 min); recovery 5 min; #2 Run, with brisk-walk recoveries: warm-up 5 min; 2 times: (1:30 min, then recovery 1:30 min, then 3 min, then recovery 3 min); recovery 5 min; #3 Run, with brisk-walk recoveries: warm-up 5 min; 3 min; recovery 1:30 min; 5 min; recovery 2:30 min; 3 min; recovery 1:30 min; 5 min; recovery 5 min; #4 Run, with brisk-walk recoveries: warm-up 5 min; 3 times: (5 min, then recovery 3 min); recovery 5 min; #5 Run, with brisk-walk recoveries: warm-up 5 min; 2 times: (10 min, then recovery 3 min); recovery 5 min; #6 Run, with brisk-walk recoveries: warm-up 5 min; 25 min; recovery 5 min; #7 Run, with brisk-walk recoveries: warm-up 5 min; 28 min; recovery 5 min; #8 Run, with brisk-walk recoveries: warm-up 5 min; 30 min; recovery 5 min.

After each session:
    - if every working set reached its target:
      - if your completed sessions this week plus 1 is at least 3: Set programme week to (your programme week plus 1), capped at 8; set completed sessions this week to 0.
      - otherwise: Raise completed sessions this week by 1.
    - if a working set fell short: Set completed sessions this week to 0.
    - if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: Leave everything as is.
